newsitem.title: USA: MAI sees Q3 profit despite higher costs.
newsitem.headline: MAI sees Q3 profit despite higher costs.

text.p: MAI Systems Corp said Wednesday said it expects to report a profit for the third quarter, despite increased expenses for completing three recent acquisitions.
MAI said it expects third quarter sales to exceed the year ago quarter's $16.5 million, and fourth quarter revenues should rise above $19 million versus $17.1 million last year.
Analysts expect MAI to earn $0.30 a share in the third quarter, according to First Call.
Profit margins, which are being hurt by the acquisition expenses, should improve in the fourth quarter, MAI said.
The acquisitions include the purchase of Hotel Information Systems, the purchase of the minority interest in its gaming systems unit, and the re-acquisition of its MANBASE customer base.
By the fourth quarter's end, increased costs from the deals, excluding goodwill of about $2.5 million annually, will have ended and will have a minimal impact on 1997 earnings.
Based on current information and assuming the acquisitions continue to be absorbed successfully, 1997 revenues should exceed 1996 revenues by a substantial margin, MAI said.

By the end of 1997, the company's transition to a software, network and professional services provider, from a provider of legacy hardware products and maintenance services, will be substantially complete, MAI said.
